title: Parameter registry of analysis v3.7 (research/detection-time/sweep_analysis_v3_7.py, research/placement/celf_v3_7.py, research/placement/score_test_v3_7.py): Hotel's off-path epoch hotel-offpath-v1, which v3.4 admits for lanes only, admitted as a campaign-E-role epoch (the Hotel arm of R1's analysis, research/traffic-sweep/BUDGET_TS_PLACEMENT_20261015.md, 2501e86; scope extension by the user 2026-10-15 ~07:30Z), and the pass rule it is scored under. parameters_v3_4.json, parameters_v3_3.json, parameters_v3_2.json and parameters_v3_6.json are not changed.
provenanceRule: Protocol decision 37: every hyperparameter is traced to its origin. A separate file, so that parameters_v3_4.json (sha256 7b8b921f..., FREEZE_V34_20261015.md) and parameters_v3_6.json (FREEZE_V36_20261015.md) stay byte-identical. Written 2026-10-15 against the Hotel harness 9ad0b98 (DECLARATION_HOTEL_OFFPATH.md 4945293, plan 90b7b621...), read-only. Every entry is `active`.

parameters.name: V37_EPOCH_PROFILES

design.note: informational except rates, postures and the regimes, which the reader enforces; the block number is read as 1..blocks

parameters.unit: study-epoch name -> cell profile, in V34_EPOCH_PROFILES's shape; ADDED to v3.3's table for the duration of a v3.7 run (v3.4 keeps it out of that table); differs from v3.4's entry in exactly one key, role (offpath-hotel -> campaign-E; asserted at import).
parameters.origin_ref: user, 2026-10-15 ~07:30Z ('strengthen it via the last set of runs'): the Hotel off-path epoch analysed like R1's TeaStore epoch, trained on blocks 1-3 and scored on blocks 4-5. Every other key is parameters_v3_4.json's (regimes no-fault-calibration, consul-pause-effect -> consul, search-pause-effect -> search, both pause; rates 10 and 1; posture full; 5 blocks, 6 cells per block, 30 cells).

parameters.name: V37_SPLIT
parameters.origin_ref: as V36_SPLIT; equal to V32_E_SPLIT (asserted at import); research/protocol/split_hotel_offpath.json has the same content (byte-identical to split_f_otel.json).

parameters.name: V37_PASS_RULE
parameters.unit: score_test_v3_2 rule list {set, class, rate, minGain, minImprovedEpisodes, minEpisodes}
parameters.origin_ref: F's pass rule (V32_PASS_RULE, decisions 99, 110, 112) mapped to this epoch as V36_PASS_RULE is to TeaStore's: the off-path class consul-pause-effect at each rate (10 and 1 req/s) separately; strictly positive g, strict improvement on >= 2 test episodes of the class at that rate, a dash below 2 valid test episodes (decision 91) or with a member absent (decision 90). search-pause-effect (on-path control) carries no verdict. Decision 73 unchanged.

parameters.name: V37_TIERS_RULE
parameters.value: Hotel has no effort/runtime tier file in celf_v3_2's schema (research/placement/declared/hotel.json is the older family table): celf_v3_7 is run without one (no --tiers), so every candidate is in tiersMissingForGroundSet and only the (effort<=any, runtime<=any) cell admits it. No tier is invented. The pass rule names that cell.
